items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And Julie can—she said, just so you know music, you can play any kind once you learn music.

ctx.x: I mean? Yes, yes. I studied music. That's all I ever played was classics. Yes. But I got interested in the—
Yes. In the jazz and— And Julie can—she said, just so you know music, you can play any kind once you learn music. Oh, yes. That's right. And he'd be 17 in August, you see, so—
Well, then you saw your brother when he was about six. He came over from Biloxi, you say?
